metadata.article_title: Penalty for default of certain provisions.

article.title: Penalty for default of certain provisions.
article.content: If any individual or director of a company makes any default in complying with any of the provisions of section 152, section 155 and section 156, such individual or director of the company shall be liable to a penalty which may extend to fifty thousand rupees and where the default is a continuing one, with a further penalty which may extend to five hundred rupees for each day after the first during which such default continues.]
article.html:
1591[Penalty for default of certain provisions.

Section 159 · Chapter XI · page 111 of the Act

If any individual or director of a company makes any default in complying with any of the provisions of section 152, section 155 and section 156, such individual or director of the company shall be liable to a penalty which may extend to fifty thousand rupees and where the default is a continuing one, with a further penalty which may extend to five hundred rupees for each day after the first during which such default continues.]

1 Subs. by Act 22 of 2019, s. 25, for section 159 (w.e.f. 2-11-2018).
